prompts.west:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: one pixel-art barn sprite, opposite side view (building RIGHT side, game-facing WEST). Image 1 is the approved EAST-side sprite: it is the strict material, color, silhouette and height reference. Image 2 is ONLY a structural reference for the timber annex in the opposite view.
Create the opposite side of this SAME barn, not a new design. Preserve image 1's brown curved shingled roof, width-to-height ratio 88:107, white horizontal eave at about 61% height, vivid red vertical plank wall, BRIGHT WHITE side corner posts. Match the rich shaded pixel texture in image 1; do not mute the white or switch it to beige. The roof ridge and eave are exactly horizontal, no gable visible and no far roof strip above the ridge. Keep the roof silhouette and roof material essentially identical to image 1.
Only the lower near-side timber annex differs: below a clearly visible strip of red wall, a low attached wooden structure reaches the common ground line, like image 2. Its top is a SHALLOW nearly horizontal lid with two crossed flat timber straps, not a vertical X gate across the wall. The annex occupies the bottom 27% of full height; its shallow lid only the upper 7% of that. Below it is a solid short wall of horizontal brown timber boards, with a few dark metal nails. White corner trims remain visible at the edges and above this low annex. NO door, no doorway, no window in this elevation.
One isolated full sprite, all extremities visible, front-on fixed elevated game camera, no perspective yaw or receding side face. Same overall proportions as first reference. Transparent RGBA background, no backdrop, no floor, no shadow, no labels, no guide lines, no text. Pixel-art treatment, crisp square pixel edges.
prompts.north:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one pixel-art barn rear sprite (BACK view, game-facing NORTH). Image 1 is the APPROVED material/color reference: rich warm brown overlapping shingles, vivid deep red vertical timber wall, bright WHITE eave and corner trim. Image 2 is the exact REAR STRUCTURE reference of this same barn.
Redraw image 2 using image 1's materials while preserving image 2's recognisable gambrel/bowed barn roof, central roof ridge, solid rear red plank wall, and low narrow timber annex attached on the LEFT. Overall silhouette ratio approximately 112 wide by 107 high; barn body roughly 96 wide, annex 16 wide. Roof top apex and bottom ground line should be the same height span as image 1. The roof is viewed with the Stardew fixed elevated camera, NOT isometric and no camera yaw.
The enclosed rear wall has no door and no window. Main visible roof eave has a clear continuous bright white painted edge, with matching bright white vertical corner posts. Preserve that vivid white: do not turn it beige or gray. Annex stays on LEFT, is narrow and shorter than the barn; its small lid has two crossed timber straps following its lid plane, as in image 2. All bottom edges meet one straight baseline. Same warm three-dimensional pixel shingles as image 1, not a new roof material; keep distinctive barn roof shape rather than a simple triangle.
One isolated full rear elevation only. Transparent RGBA background with actual alpha, no backdrop, no floor or cast shadow, no text, no label, no guide lines. Crisp pixel-art edges. Do not copy the front human or animal entrances onto the rear.
